queries: WITH telescope_weather AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_group_modindex FROM telescope_weather) SELECT tw.weathprofile, AVG(tw.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(tw.avg_phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg, AVG(tw.avg_modindex - b.mean_group_modindex) AS avg_modindex_above_baseline FROM telescope_weather AS tw CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE tw.avg_modindex > b.mean_group_modindex GROUP BY tw.weathprofile;
